**Enum** in the `Latiprimere.Rendering` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Abstractions](/docs/reference/#latiprimereabstractions) package.

```csharp
public enum RasterPixelFormat
```

How a rendered band's pixels are laid out in memory.

Values may be added in a later version, such as a format for a kind of printer not yet covered. An [IRasterDocument](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/irasterdocument/) throws [NotSupportedException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.notsupportedexception) for a format it can't render, and code that reads pixels should do the same for a format it doesn't know, rather than guess its layout.

## Values

- **`Bgra32`** (`0`): 32 bits a pixel, in B, G, R, unused byte order: the layout of a top-down 32-bit Windows device-independent bitmap.
- **`Gray8`** (`1`): 8 bits a pixel of grey, 0 black and 255 white, for monochrome printers: a quarter of the memory of [RasterPixelFormat.Bgra32](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/rasterpixelformat/#values).
